newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall 1.29 pct after recent rally.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall 1.29 pct after recent rally.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.29 percent in profit-taking after the recent sharp gains and consecutive record closes, brokers said.
The IMKB-100 .ISEC closed at 91,602.66, down 1,195.05 points from Tuesday's all-time high of 92,797.71. It plunged to a low of 90,829 in the afternoon from an early high of 94,001.
It had gained 1.13 percent in the last two days on top of last week's 5.49 percent surge and hit seven records in a row.
Trade volume retreated to 16.17 trillion lira from 17.61 trillion on Tuesday.

"There was a drop in weak volume due to market saturation after the recent strong rises. The index met support at 90,500. It may drift within 90,000-94,000 band for a while," said Nazmi Sarikaya from Disbank.

Of the 230 shares traded, losers outdid gainers by 128 to 55 and 47 were steady. The 85-share industrial index .ISEI slipped 0.41 percent lower to 97,600.96 and the 15-share financial index .ISEF dived 3.23 percent to 87,000.15.

Leading actives were largely state-owned flat steel producer Eregli, down 250 lira at 13,500 and Koc Holding, down 750 lira at 21,000. The two made up 19.8 percent of the total turnover. -- Aydan Eksin, Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
